# Building SCHISM-AED {.unnumbered}

*This chapter describes how to compile the coupled `pschism_AED` executable and
the post-processing tools from source.*

SCHISM-AED is built from the **AED_Tools** umbrella repository, which fetches the
upstream SCHISM source, patches it with the AED-coupling glue, and compiles
`pschism_AED` together with the SCHISM utilities — including
`combine_output11_MPI`.

::: {.callout-tip}
A condensed version of this build recipe (and the run/health-check steps in the
next chapters) is kept alongside the file table in
`docs/quick-start/SCHISM_AED_file_table.md`. This chapter is the fuller account.
:::

## Prerequisites

On Ubuntu 22.04 (or similar):

```bash
sudo apt install libopenmpi-dev
sudo apt install libnetcdf-dev libnetcdff-dev
```

You also need `git`, `make`, `gcc`, `gfortran` (≥ 9, for modern Fortran /
`std=f2018`), and CMake for the SCHISM core build.

## Full build flow

```bash
# 1. Clone the umbrella repo
git clone https://github.com/AquaticEcoDynamics/AED_Tools
cd AED_Tools/

# 2. Pull the SCHISM source tree and all AED libraries
./fetch_sources.sh schism
./fetch_sources.sh all

# 3. Install runtime deps (see above) if not already present

# 4. Convenience symlink expected by the patch
ln -s schism a

# 5. Apply the AED-coupling patch to SCHISM
patch -p0 < schism-aed/aed-schism.xdiff

# 6. Graft AED into SCHISM's source tree
cd schism/src
ln -s ../../schism-aed/src/AED .
cd ../..

# 7. Compile
./build_schism.sh --with-aed

# 8. Confirm the executables landed
ls binaries/ubuntu/22.04/
```

Typical build time on a multi-core VM is **3–8 minutes**.

## What gets built, and where

`build_schism.sh --with-aed` produces:

- **`pschism_AED_..._TVD-VL`** — the main model executable (the long suffix
  encodes the build options); often copied/symlinked to `pschism_AED`.
- **`combine_output11_MPI`** — under `schism/build/bin/`, the post-process binary
  that assembles per-rank AED outputs.
- **`combine_hotstart7`** — combines per-rank hotstart files for restarts.

```
AED_Tools/
├── libaed-water/ libaed-benthic/ libaed-demo/ libaed-api/   AED libraries
├── schism/build/bin/
│   ├── pschism_AED_..._TVD-VL    the model executable
│   ├── combine_output11_MPI      the per-rank AED combiner
│   └── combine_hotstart7         hotstart combiner
└── binaries/ubuntu/<version>/    copies of the main executables
```

::: {.callout-note}
The Pioneer runs use a `GEN`-enabled build
(`pschism_AED_GEN_BLD_STANDALONE_SH_MEM_COMM_TVD-VL`) so that SCHISM-native
general tracers are available — see
[AED & tracers](../part2-model-setup/09-aed-and-tracers.qmd).
:::

## Build flags

`build_schism.sh` accepts flags for optional features. On a standard Ubuntu host
with apt-provided OpenMPI + NetCDF, plain `--with-aed` is enough.

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--with-aed` | Compile and link AED (required for SCHISM-AED) |
| `--need-netcdf_c` / `--need-netcdf_f` | Build NetCDF-C / Fortran from source (if system version too old) |
| `--need-openmpi` / `--need-mpich` | Build the MPI stack from source |
| `--all` | Shorthand: extras + netcdf-c + netcdf-f + openmpi + gd |

Run `./build_schism.sh --help` for the full list.

## Common build issues

- **Transient `HYDRAULIC_STRUCTURES.mod` copy error** — a filesystem race in
  parallel `make -j` builds on network shares (Dropbox/CIFS/NFS). Just re-run the
  build; if it persists, `make -j1` inside `schism/build/` serialises and reveals
  the real error.
- **`--need-netcdf-f` typo warning** — the flag uses an underscore
  (`--need-netcdf_f`); the dash form is a non-fatal warning.
- **MPI signature warnings** (`INTEGER(4)/REAL(8)` from `schism_msgp.F90` etc.) —
  upstream SCHISM warnings, harmless, not introduced by AED.
- **"Only NCS_ss1 registers" on a fresh AED run** — a `_FillValue` type-check
  failure on stricter NetCDF/HDF5 stacks. See the SCHISM skill's
  `faq-and-gotchas.md` for the fix.
